source.body:
### Bug Description

When you open an AI node after a run, such as an AI Agent, the **Logs** view in the output panel shows each input and output block with a small switch: "Rendered" and "JSON". These two labels are written in English straight into the code, so they do not get translated.

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/d919f0f131c358fee20142c1e719bf6ee803c96f/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/ndv/runData/components/ai/AiRunContentBlock.vue#L108-L109

The display mode switch above the output already uses `runData.rendered` and `runData.json` for the same words.

### To Reproduce

1. Set the UI to a language other than English.
2. Run a workflow with an AI Agent node and a chat model.
3. Open the AI Agent node and go to the **Logs** view in the output panel.
4. Look at an input or output block. The "Rendered" and "JSON" switch is still in English.

### Expected behavior

The switch labels show in the selected language, like the display mode switch above them.

### Debug Info

I found this while reading the code on `master` (2.48.0). The text is written into the code, so it happens on every setup.

### Environment

- Operating System: macOS (platform independent)
- n8n Version: 2.48.0 (`master`)
- Node.js Version: 24.x
- Database: n/a
- Execution mode: n/a

### Note

I have a fix ready and will open a PR.
